cards.need: My sensor array was stripped by micrometeorites, and I am flying blind toward a pulsar.
cards.stakes: Without replacement shielding for the optics, the radiation will blind me and fry my ship's controls in a matter of hours.
cards.board_text: Mayday! I took a bad hit in a dust cloud and my primary sensor shielding is gone. I am drifting too close to a pulsar, and the interference is already cooking my readouts. I need a load of rad-quartz to harden the backup array before the radiation blinds my ship entirely. Get it to me now!

cards.need: My new zero-gravity tanning bed is emitting far too much ultraviolet, and I am turning an unappealing shade of magenta.
cards.stakes: I will be laughed off the set of my latest movie if I arrive looking like a boiled crustacean.
cards.board_text: Disaster! Absolute disaster! My customized tanning pod is malfunctioning, and it is bombarding me with unfiltered radiation. I need industrial rad-quartz to shield the bulbs immediately. I am scheduled to film the big romance scene tomorrow, and I refuse to do it while glowing in the dark. Bring the quartz!

cards.need: I am building a specialized telescope to observe a distant nebula that emits massive amounts of hard radiation.
cards.stakes: It has been my lifelong dream to capture a clear image of that phenomenon with my own equipment.
cards.board_text: I have spent years assembling the lenses for a custom observatory array. The only thing missing is a layer of rad-quartz to protect the delicate optical sensors from the deep-space glare. It is not an emergency, but I would pay handsomely to finally finish this project and see the colors of the nebula for myself.

cards.need: The structural struts on our new solar array are expanding unevenly as we rotate into the sun, and the frame is buckling.
cards.stakes: If the array collapses, it will crush the habitat module below it and kill everyone inside.
cards.board_text: We have a critical engineering failure! The contractor used cheap alloys for the new solar collectors. As the station turns toward the star, the heat differential is warping the struts. We need cryo-ferrite immediately to reinforce the frame. If that array snaps off, it will tear the main habitat apart!

cards.need: I am carving a masterpiece out of frozen methane, and my standard tools are warping from the temperature changes.
cards.stakes: The grand exhibition is this weekend, and my magnum opus currently looks like a melted puddle.
cards.board_text: Art requires sacrifice, but it should not require shoddy tools! Every time I take my carving frame out of the freezer, the metal expands and ruins the delicate methane shaving process. I require cryo-ferrite struts to build a temperature-stable workbench. If my ice sculpture thaws, the critics will destroy me!

cards.need: I need to rebuild the hidden compartment on my ship so it stops rattling when I fly near a star.
cards.stakes: That compartment holds the only mementos I have left of my family, and I cannot stand hearing them bang around.
cards.board_text: My ship is a rusted bucket, and the secret hold in the floorboards warps every time we hit the heat of a system's inner orbits. I need some cryo-ferrite to frame it properly. It is not for contraband. It is just for keeping some old family pictures safe without them getting crushed when the hull shifts.

cards.need: A damaged freighter just limped into the bay, and its primary fuel containment is leaking into our atmosphere.
cards.stakes: If we don't transfer the unstable fuel to a fresh pod, the resulting explosion will vaporize the entire trading post.
cards.board_text: Evacuation protocols are in effect! We have a crippled hauler in the main dock with a failing containment field. The antimatter is eating through the secondary bulkheads as we speak. I need a pristine anti-matter containment pod dropped here immediately to siphon the fuel. Do not crash on your way in, or you will take us all with you!

cards.need: I bet the other mechanics I could build a personal hoverbike that runs on weapons-grade fuel.
cards.stakes: If I cannot contain the fuel source, my workshop will be a crater, and worse, I will lose the bet.
cards.board_text: Listen, I may have made a slight miscalculation. I need an anti-matter containment pod, and I need it before my custom hoverbike dissolves my garage. The boys said it was impossible to power a bike with starship fuel, and I am going to prove them wrong! I just need to stop the engine block from spontaneously disintegrating first.

cards.need: I have discovered a safe way to neutralize unstable antimatter, but I need a certified pod to transport my prototype catalyst.
cards.stakes: Presenting this research is my only chance to get my academic credentials back.
cards.board_text: The university expelled me for my theoretical work on safe containment, calling me a madman. I have finally perfected the neutralizing compound, but the transport authority will not let me carry it without an official anti-matter containment pod. Bring me one, and I will prove to the entire sector that my theories were right all along.

cards.need: An unknown parasite is spreading through our security team, and we need to freeze the first infected guard to study the life cycle.
cards.stakes: Without a frozen subject to safely dissect, the infection will consume the entire local population by tomorrow.
cards.board_text: Code red in the security wing. Three guards are down with an aggressive alien parasite, and the medical bays are overwhelmed. I need a portable stasis pod right now. We have to put Patient Zero into suspended animation so the doctors can figure out how to kill the bug without it spreading further. Hurry!

cards.need: I accidentally created the perfect souffle, and it will collapse in five minutes if I do not freeze time.
cards.stakes: I cannot remember the exact ingredient ratio, so this single pastry is my only path to culinary immortality.
cards.board_text: Stop what you are doing and bring me a portable stasis pod! I have achieved the impossible - a flawless, zero-gravity souffle that defies the laws of physics. But it is starting to deflate! I must put it into suspended animation immediately so the culinary board can witness its majesty. Do not drop it!

cards.need: I am transporting a bouquet of rare flowers for my partner's birthday, and the ship's climate control just failed.
cards.stakes: It took me months to afford these blooms, and I want them to be perfect when I arrive.
cards.board_text: I feel so foolish asking for this, but I need a portable stasis pod. The heater on my transport died, and the exotic flowers I bought for my partner are beginning to wilt in the cold. It is their first birthday since we moved out here, and I just want the flowers to stay exactly as beautiful as when I bought them.
